title: The Most Misunderstood Concept in Physics
summary: Veritasium's explainer on entropy, presented as one of physics' most important and least understood concepts. It uses examples such as heat engines and the sun's energy flowing through the Earth.
why: HN commenters say it made entropy intuition click and point to it in threads on energy, heat and equilibrium.

quote.text: This veritasium video explained it in a way that finally clicked for me
